description: This file is a jQuery plugin implementation of unobtrusive user notifications called jGrowl, version 1.4.5, including plugin setup, default settings, and methods for creating, rendering, updating, and shutting down notifications.

methods.name: jGrowl
methods.description: Creates a notification on the default jGrowl container or initializes the container if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.create
methods.description: Creates a new notification with specified message and options.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.render
methods.description: Renders a notification element in the container.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.update
methods.description: Updates the notification container, removing expired notifications.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.startup
methods.description: Initializes the notification container and starts the update interval.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.shutdown
methods.description: Removes the notification container and stops updates.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.close
methods.description: Triggers the closing of all notifications.
